temp_path.description: Directory for temporary GIMP files (e.g., layer caches).

swap_path.description: Directory for swap tiles — used when tile-cache-size is exceeded.

swap_compression.description: Compression algorithm for swap tiles: 'fast', 'medium', or 'max'.

num_processors.description: Number of threads for multithreaded operations. Set to 0 for auto-detect.

tile_cache_size.description: Memory limit before swapping tiles to disk. Supports K/M/G/B suffixes.

use_opencl.description: Whether to use OpenCL for GPU-accelerated operations.

default_threshold.description: Default threshold for region-filling tools (e.g., Fuzzy Select).

plug_in_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for plug-ins.

module_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for GIMP modules (e.g., color management).

interpreter_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for script interpreters (e.g., Python, Perl).

environ_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for environment config files.

brush_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for brushes.

brush_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable brush directories.

dynamics_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for paint dynamics.

dynamics_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable dynamics directories.

mypaint_brush_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for MyPaint brushes.

mypaint_brush_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable MyPaint brush directories.

pattern_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for patterns.

pattern_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable pattern directories.

palette_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for palettes.

palette_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable palette directories.

gradient_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for gradients.

gradient_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable gradient directories.

tool_preset_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for tool presets.

tool_preset_path_writable.description: Colon-separated list of writable tool preset directories.

font_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories to search for fonts (in addition to system fonts).

default_brush.description: Name of the default brush to select on startup.

default_dynamics.description: Name of the default paint dynamics.

default_mypaint_brush.description: Name of the default MyPaint brush.

default_tool_preset.description: Name of the default tool preset.

global_brush.description: Whether brush selection is global across tools.

global_dynamics.description: Whether dynamics selection is global across tools.

global_pattern.description: Whether pattern selection is global across tools.

global_palette.description: Whether palette selection is global across tools.

global_gradient.description: Whether gradient selection is global across tools.

global_font.description: Whether font selection is global across tools.

default_image.description: Parameters for new images created via File > New.

default_grid.description: Default grid appearance and spacing for new images.

undo_levels.description: Minimum number of undo steps to always keep.

undo_size.description: Memory limit for undo history per image (K/M/G/B suffixes supported).

undo_preview_size.description: Size of undo history previews: 'tiny', 'extra-small', 'small', 'medium', 'large', etc.

plug_in_history_size.description: Number of recent plug-ins to keep in the Filters menu.

pluginrc_path.description: Path to file storing plug-in registration cache.

layer_previews.description: Whether to generate layer/channel previews in dialogs (impacts performance).

group_layer_previews.description: Whether to generate layer-group previews (expensive for large trees).

thumbnail_filesize_limit.description: Files smaller than this will have thumbnails regenerated on open.

color_management.description: Color management behavior (display, simulation, gamut warnings, etc.).

save_document_history.description: Whether to permanently record opened/saved files in Recent Documents.

quick_mask_color.description: RGBA color for quick mask overlay (red, green, blue, alpha in 0–1 range).

import_promote_float.description: Whether to promote imported images to floating-point precision.

import_promote_dither.description: Whether to add noise when promoting to floating-point precision.

import_add_alpha.description: Whether to add alpha channel to layers of imported images.

import_raw_plug_in.description: Plug-in name used to import raw camera files (e.g., 'darkroom').

export_file_type.description: Default file format for export: 'png', 'jpg', 'ora', etc.

export_color_profile.description: Whether to embed image color profile during export.

export_metadata_exif.description: Whether to export Exif metadata by default.

export_metadata_xmp.description: Whether to export XMP metadata by default.

export_metadata_iptc.description: Whether to export IPTC metadata by default.

check_updates.description: Whether to automatically check for GIMP updates in background.

snap_distance.description: Distance (pixels) where guides/grids snap to cursor.

marching_ants_speed.description: Speed of selection outline animation (ms — lower = faster).

resize_windows_on_zoom.description: Whether to resize image window when zoom changes (multi-window mode only).

resize_windows_on_resize.description: Whether to resize image window when physical image size changes (multi-window mode).

default_show_all.description: Whether new images are shown fully fitted by default.

default_dot_for_dot.description: Whether to map one image pixel to one screen pixel by default.

initial_zoom_to_fit.description: Whether to fit image to window on file open (else 1:1 view).

cursor_updating.description: Whether to update context-sensitive cursor overlays.

show_brush_outline.description: Whether to draw brush outline preview while painting.

snap_brush_outline.description: Whether brush outline snaps to individual dabs.

show_paint_tool_cursor.description: Whether to show cursor over image during paint operations.

image_title_format.description: Format string for image window titles (supports %f, %D, %t, etc.).
